cause: Audit v1 re-read mutable worker PIDs after the immutable progress snapshot. Normal per-board worker turnover made the later PID set differ and could transiently reduce the live count,so the auditor incorrectly treated a time-varying observation as immutable evidence.
correction: Audit v2 verifies worker count,PIDs,coordinator identity and priority from the already immutable independent progress artifact whose hash is frozen by the correction;it does not demand later PID equality.
